content.title: Inception
content.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
content.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

Title: Inception

Tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

Overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

Genres: Action, Science Fiction, Adventure

Production Companies: Warner Bros. Pictures

Production Countries: United Kingdom, United States of America

Spoken Languages: English, French, Japanese, Swahili
